confirmed_task:
On Debian Packages, open the Bookworm curl package. Report the package version, every architecture listed in the Download curl table, and every required package shown under Depends, including its displayed version constraint.

Stopping condition: Stop after the Bookworm package version, complete architecture list, and all required dependencies have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not download or install the package.
- Remain on the Debian Bookworm package page.
- Include only packages under Depends; exclude Recommends, Suggests, and similar optional relationships.

items.criterion: Access the Debian Bookworm curl package page (packages.debian.org/bookworm/curl)
items.description: Use the Debian Packages Bookworm page for curl. Full credit if the agent attempts to access packages.debian.org/bookworm/curl but is blocked by an external issue (e.g., site outage, CAPTCHA, network error) and clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent uses Debian Packages but not clearly the Bookworm curl page (e.g., wrong release) while describing the mismatch. No credit if the agent uses an unrelated source without noting inability to access the required page.

items.criterion: Report the Bookworm curl package version
items.description: Record the exact curl version string shown on the Bookworm curl page. Full credit for an exact match, or if the agent cannot view the version due to an external access/rendering issue and explicitly states that. Partial credit for an incomplete but clearly Bookworm-tied version (e.g., missing Debian revision suffix) when the page is otherwise accessible. No credit for a version from a different release/source without explaining a blocker.

items.criterion: List every architecture in the 'Download curl' table
items.description: Provide the complete set of architectures listed in the 'Download curl' table on the Bookworm curl page. Full credit if all listed architectures are included with none missing, OR if the agent cannot access/see the table due to an external issue (page section not loading, blocked access) and clearly reports that limitation. Partial credit if most architectures are listed but one or more are missing or an extra non-listed architecture is included. No credit if architectures are omitted without any noted blocker.

items.criterion: List all required dependencies under 'Depends' with displayed version constraints
items.description: Extract and report every package shown under the Depends section for Bookworm curl, including each displayed version constraint exactly as shown. Must exclude Recommends, Suggests, Pre-Depends, Breaks, Conflicts, and other non-Depends relations. Full credit for a complete and accurate Depends list with correct constraints, OR if the agent is unable to view the Depends section due to an external access/rendering issue and explicitly states that. Partial credit if the correct Depends packages are mostly identified but one or more constraints are missing/incorrect, or if one dependency is missed. No credit if dependencies are largely incorrect, include optional relations, or are omitted without noting a blocker.

items.criterion: Respect constraints (no download/install; remain on Bookworm package page; stop after recording required info)
items.description: Do not download or install anything. Remain on the Debian Bookworm curl package page while collecting the required information, and stop after reporting the Bookworm version, complete architecture list, and all Depends. Full credit if these constraints are respected (minor unavoidable redirects within packages.debian.org to the same Bookworm curl context are acceptable). Partial credit if there is unnecessary extra navigation but no download/install occurs and constraints are otherwise respected. No credit if the agent downloads/installs the package or violates the stop condition in a way that materially departs from the task.
